A [[Sigil Trader]] is an [[Non-player character|NPC]] [[trader]] who [[trade]]s [[Celestial Sigil]]s, which are used to obtain a [[guild hall]]. The Celestial Sigils' current price can be viewed by selecting request quote, the selling price is dynamically generated according to [[Trade#Trading with NPCs|supply and demand]]. 

==Locations==
*[[Core]]
**[[Battle Isles]]
***{{NPC location|Heroes' Ascent|outpost}}
***Visited [[guild hall]]s (see [[Canthan Ambassador]])
*[[Prophecies]]
**[[Crystal Desert]]
***{{NPC location|Tomb of the Primeval Kings}} (does not appear in [[Territory|International]] [[District]]s)

==Dialogue==
:''"I can trade you Celestial Sigils at the current market price, based on supply and demand. If you'd prefer to earn a sigil on your own, you can win them in [[The Hall of Heroes (arena)|the Hall of Heroes]], find them in [[Zaishen Strongbox]]es, or trade for them with [[Jessie Llam]] in the [[Great Temple of Balthazar]].
:''Traders only sell items that they have purchased from [[player]]s, and prices constantly fluctuate based on supply and demand. Before buying, you must request a quote to get the current price."

:''"Select an item from your [[inventory]] below, click "Request Quote," and then click "Sell."''
:''Traders only buy items that they are going to sell to players, and prices constantly fluctuate based on supply and demand. Before selling you must request a quote to get the current price."

==Notes==
{{bug|After the [[Feedback:Game updates/20130207|February 7, 2013 update]] (which made Celestial Sigils sellable to [[merchant]]s), she will only pay the merchant value for a Celestial Sigil (i.e. {{cost|1000}} for [[:File:Sigil Trader bug.jpg|Celestial Sigils acquired after that update]]), even though the "last paid" price displays a higher amount. If a Celestial Sigil acquired before that update has been [[Identification|identified]], she will pay the [[:File:Sigil Trader Celestial Sigil acquired before the February 7, 2013 update.jpg|identified merchant value of that Celestial Sigil]].)}}

==Trivia==
*Her dialogue was changed in or sometime after the February 7, 2013 update to mention that Celestial Sigils are also available from Zaishen Strongboxes and Jessie Llam.
